WITH player_vote_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.death_country,
        AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) AS player_average
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p
      ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL
      AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL
      AND v.points_max <> 0
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country
), country_averages AS (
    SELECT death_country, AVG(player_average) AS average_ratio
    FROM player_vote_averages
    GROUP BY death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    average_ratio,
    average_ratio / AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS relative_to_country_mean
FROM country_averages;
